how_to_use: Paste the 'style' block plus ONE asset's 'prompt' into ChatGPT per image. Ask for a PNG with a transparent background.
Generate everything at 1024x1024. Do not try to make tiny images; the build script shrinks them.
Save each result into assets/icons/src/ using the exact 'filename'. Then run: python assets/build_icons.py
Chat icons end up 11x11 px in game, so they must be one bold silhouette. Anything thin, detailed or with text turns to mud at that size.

style.brand: C o R clan mascot: a rhinoceros with an oversized single horn. Aggressive, heavy metal style. Horn is the hero element.
rules_for_all_icons: Flat vector illustration, 2 to 4 solid colors, no gradients, no shading, no outlines thinner than 6% of the canvas width.
Single centered subject filling about 90% of the canvas. Transparent background. No text, no border, no drop shadow, no glow.
Must still be recognisable when shrunk to 11x11 pixels: think emoji or app icon, not illustration.
Black outlines are fine to include; the build script removes them before shrinking, so the colored fill is what has to carry the shape.
rules_for_logo: Flat vector, can use a little shading. Transparent background outside the circle. No text.

assets.prompt: Emblem: front-facing rhinoceros head inside a solid black circle, oversized red single horn pointing up, red dripping blood-like paint running down from the horn base, angry glowing red eyes, grey and white face plates. Flat vector, bold shapes, transparent background outside the circle. No text.

Ultra-simplified rhino head icon: dark grey head silhouette with one huge bright red horn, two tiny red eye dots, on a solid black circle. 3 colors only, thick shapes, app-icon style, transparent background outside the circle. No text.
